parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by the document ChEMBL ID. Sort by the molecule ChEMBL ID and return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles.
